PHP 8.4+ only; add `declare(strict_types=1);` to every PHP file. Make classes final unless inheritance is required; use readonly properties wherever possible, constructor property promotion, typed properties/return types, and PSR-12. Never use `var_dump()` or `dd()` in production code.

Base: `VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk`; Data: `VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk.Data`; Requests: `VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk\Requests`; Enums: `VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk\Enums`. DTOs are `final readonly`; requests extend `Saloon\Http\Request` and are `final`; enums are backed string/int enums. Use traits for shared functionality (`Traits/`); member-only requests must use `RequiresMemberAuth`. `DataCite.php` is the main client; organize `Requests/` by API endpoint and put response DTOs in `Data/`. Type all responses with Data DTOs. Use `HasPaginationParams`, `HasFieldParams`, `HasIdParams`; follow Data/ naming conventions. Use typed arrays in DocBlocks: `<REDACTED_USER> DoiObject[]`.

Public API: read-only, unauthenticated GET. Member API: POST/PUT/DELETE, member-specific data, or DOI modifications require `RequiresMemberAuth`; import `VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk\Traits\Requests\RequiresMemberAuth;`. Create DOI requires member auth: `final class CreateDOI extends Request`, `use RequiresMemberAuth;  // Enforces member auth requirement`, `protected Method $method = Method::POST;`.

Run before committing: `composer test`, `composer lint`, `composer test:unit`, `composer test:types`, `composer refactor`.
